source: independent (non-author) pred-scout-coach-critic reviewing data/postgame/*.json coaching against the match facts; preference-based / ungrounded lines flagged; grounded rewrites applied back

4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Down four towers before we had touched one of theirs, with two Fangtooths and a Genesis Core gone the same way, the map was theirs. Then the buildings fell the other way: both Primal Fangtooths, Orb Prime, three inhibitors and the Core. Three of our four won fights became an objective or structure; they converted half of their ten. We also took a tower and the first Primal Fangtooth in the same windows as fights we lost. Taking the map, more than winning fights, is how this flipped.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: 'touched' overclaims: the facts record structure takes, not whether we had damaged any of their towers

4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Maco did the support job that shows up on paper: the most healing in the lobby, our highest mitigation, more wards than Argus and a hand in over half our kills. The bodies were the cost. Khaimera killed him four times, and one death outside any fight came just before our first tower and their first Fangtooth fell. Next game, when Gadget drops Tesla Dome on our group, Maco fires Phantom Rush so everyone walks out through the slow.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: takeaway targets Gadget's dome, which no match event ties to Maco's story; the supported problem is Khaimera's four kills on him
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.rewrite: Maco did the support job that shows up on paper: the most healing in the lobby, our highest mitigation, more wards than Argus and a hand in over half our kills. The bodies were the cost. Khaimera killed him four times, and one death outside any fight came just before our first tower and their first Fangtooth fell. When Khaimera leaps onto Sparrow or Maco, Maco fires Phantom Rush so the duo walks out through Ambush's slow.

4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.quote: Maco skipped the common support core of Crescelia, Enra's Blessing and Windcaller for a front-line kit. Hexbound Bracers returns mana from damage taken and trims hero basic-attack damage; Tainted Guard adds armor and cuts the healing of whoever basic-attacks him, Khaimera included. Frosted Lure pulses damage, a slow and a shield while he stays near enemies, and Vyzar Carapace shields after repeated hits. Timewarp shortens basic cooldowns. It fits our highest mitigation; it does not prove the build won or lost any fight.
4dea0473-d3c5-444d-b8ef-e9b015ab43ab.issue: Vyzar Carapace mechanic misleading: its shield triggers when Maco's own attacks and abilities stack three hits on an enemy hero, not on being hit
